title: Probabilistic Relevance Decisions for Semantic Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.08014v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dense similarity supplies reusable corpus representations, while probabilistic relevance decisions offer query-dependent document scoring. We compare dense-only BGE-M3 with TypeSafe Jev Noul and OpenAI Decisions Predicate scores on the official BEIR SciFact test benchmark. The study evaluates 300 official test queries using identical positive-enriched 100-document pools and full-corpus dense retrieval followed by reranking at candidate depths of 50 and 100. Unlike the controlled pools, neither dense prefix receives positive injection. Jev has the highest observed Recall@5 and nDCG@10 under the evaluated conditions. At depth 50, full-corpus nDCG@10 is 0.6413 for BGE-M3, 0.7545 with OpenAI and 0.7805 with Jev. Extending depth from 50 to 100 increases known-positive candidate recall but produces small, uncertain final-effectiveness changes. All four paired-bootstrap depth intervals include zero. Unique-condition API scoring cost approximate

translated_title: 面向语义检索的概率相关性决策
translated_abstract: 稠密相似度提供可复用的语料库表示，而概率相关性决策则提供依赖查询的文档评分。我们在官方 BEIR SciFact 测试基准上，将仅使用稠密检索的 BGE-M3 与 TypeSafe Jev Noul 以及 OpenAI Decisions Predicate 评分进行比较。该研究对 300 个官方测试查询进行评估，使用相同的经过正例增强的 100 篇文档池，以及全语料库稠密检索后分别在候选深度 50 和 100 处进行重排序。与受控文档池不同，稠密检索前缀部分均未注入正例。在所评估的条件下，Jev 的 Recall@5 和 nDCG@10 观测值最高。在深度 50 时，全语料库 nDCG@10 为：BGE-M3 为 0.6413，OpenAI 为 0.7545，Jev 为 0.7805。将候选深度从 50 扩展到 100 提高了已知正例的候选召回率，但对最终效果的改变较小且不确定。四个配对自助法深度区间均包含零。独特条件下的 API 评分成本大约……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 在 BEIR SciFact 官方基准的全语料库稠密检索加重排序评测中，基于概率相关性决策的 Jev 评分取得了最高的 Recall@5 和 nDCG@10，优于仅稠密检索的 BGE-M3 和 OpenAI 评分，且增大候选深度带来的最终效果提升较小且统计上不确定。
en_tdlr: On the official BEIR SciFact benchmark with full-corpus dense retrieval and reranking, the probabilistic relevance decision method Jev achieves the highest Recall@5 and nDCG@10, outperforming dense-only BGE-M3 and OpenAI scoring, while increasing candidate depth yields only small, statistically uncertain gains.
